knowledge:
- key_parameters: motifs=A list of position weight matrices (PWMs) of TF motifs (e.g., PWMatrixList.rds, best_curated_Human.rds, or cluster_PWMs.rds) ;; Drerio=A BSgenome object corresponding to the genome assembly of the dataset ;; seqlev=Chromosome or sequence levels to restrict the search (e.g., "chr1") ;; grange=A GRanges object representing the genomic regions (e.g., merged peak list) to scan for binding sites ;; p.cutoff=P-value cutoff for motif scanning in prepareBindingSites ;; bamExp=Paths to BAM files for experimental samples (must be biologically duplicated) ;; bamCtl=Paths to BAM files for control samples (must be biologically duplicated) ;; positive=Integer to shift the 5' ends of reads on the positive strand (set to 0 if BAMs are already shifted) ;; negative=Integer to shift the 5' ends of reads on the negative strand (set to 0 if BAMs are already shifted) ;; proximal=Width of the proximal region around binding sites (suggested to keep the same as distal, e.g., 40) ;; distal=Width of the distal region around binding sites (suggested to keep the same as proximal, e.g., 40) ;; gap=Gap size between the binding site and the proximal region ;; design=Design matrix for differential analysis in DBscore ;; coef=Coefficient of interest in the design matrix for DBscore
- alternatives: MEME, HOMER, enrichr, and ChEA=Alternative tools that detect differential activity of TFs (DATFs) from differential accessibility analysis alone ;; BiFET, diffTF, and TFEA=Alternative tools that find DATFs by enrichment tests ;; Signac and chromVar=Alternative tools widely used for single-cell ATAC-seq analysis ;; fimo=An alternative external tool to generate the binding sites list instead of prepareBindingSites ;; ATACseqQC::shiftGAlignmentsList (paired-end) or shiftGAlignments (single-end)=Preferred methods to generate correctly shifted BAM files considering soft clipping, rather than using the positive/negative parameters in TFEA
- when_to_use: Use this package when you want to detect the differential activity of transcription factors between two experimental conditions using ATAC-seq data, specifically taking TF footprints (and not just open chromatin status) into account.
- pitfalls: Shifting reads using the positive and negative parameters in TFEA or count5ends does not consider soft clipping of the reads; it is highly recommended to pre-shift BAM files using ATACseqQC::shiftGAlignmentsList or shiftGAlignments first. Additionally, samples must be at least biologically duplicated to run the TFEA workflow.

workflows.name: one_step_tfea
workflows.intent: Perform transcription factor enrichment analysis (TFEA) in a single step using pre-shifted BAM files and prepared binding sites.
input: peaks.granges (GRanges object of merged peak list)
workflows.stages: 1. Load motifs and scan genome for binding sites using prepareBindingSites ;; 2. Run one-step TFEA using TFEA ;; 3. Visualize results using ESvolcanoplot, plotES, and factorFootprints
workflows.code:
motifs <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "PWMatrixList.rds",
                               package="ATACseqTFEA"))
seqlev <- "chr1" 
bindingSites <- 
  prepareBindingSites(motifs, Drerio, seqlev,
                      grange=GRanges("chr1", IRanges(5000, 100000)),
                      p.cutoff = 5e-05)#set higher p.cutoff to get more sites.
bamExp <- system.file("extdata",
                      c("KD.shift.rep1.bam",
                        "KD.shift.rep2.bam"),
                      package="ATACseqTFEA")
bamCtl <- system.file("extdata",
                      c("WT.shift.rep1.bam",
                        "WT.shift.rep2.bam"),
                      package="ATACseqTFEA")
res <- TFEA(bamExp, bamCtl, bindingSites=bindingSites,
            positive=0, negative=0) # the bam files were shifted reads
TF <- "Tal1::Gata1"
## volcanoplot
ESvolcanoplot(TFEAresults=res, TFnameToShow=TF)
### plot enrichment score for one TF
plotES(res, TF=TF, outfolder=NA)
## footprint
sigs <- factorFootprints(c(bamCtl, bamExp), 
                         pfm = as.matrix(motifs[[TF]]),
                         bindingSites = getBindingSites(res, TF=TF),
                         seqlev = seqlev, genome = Drerio,
                         upstream = 100, downstream = 100,
                         group = rep(c("WT", "KD"), each=2))
## export the results into a csv file
write.csv(res$resultsTable, tempfile(fileext = ".csv"), 
          row.names=FALSE)

workflows.name: step_by_step_tfea
workflows.intent: Perform transcription factor enrichment analysis step-by-step to allow parameter tuning at intermediate stages.
input: bindingSites.granges (GRanges object of prepared binding sites)
workflows.stages: 1. Expand binding sites to define proximal and distal regions using expandBindingSites ;; 2. Count 5' ends of reads in the defined regions using count5ends ;; 3. Filter low-count binding sites using eventsFilter ;; 4. Normalize counts to count per base (CPB) using countsNormalization ;; 5. Calculate weighted binding scores using getWeightedBindingScore ;; 6. Perform differential binding analysis using DBscore ;; 7. Run TF enrichment analysis using doTFEA ;; 8. Plot enrichment scores using plotES
workflows.code:
# prepare the counting region
exbs <- expandBindingSites(bindingSites=bindingSites,
                           proximal=40,
                           distal=40,
                           gap=10)
## count reads by 5'ends
counts <- count5ends(bam=c(bamExp, bamCtl),
                     positive=0L, negative=0L,
                     bindingSites = bindingSites,
                     bindingSitesWithGap=exbs$bindingSitesWithGap,
                     bindingSitesWithProximal=exbs$bindingSitesWithProximal,
                     bindingSitesWithProximalAndGap=
                         exbs$bindingSitesWithProximalAndGap,
                     bindingSitesWithDistal=exbs$bindingSitesWithDistal)
colnames(counts)
counts <- eventsFilter(counts, "proximalRegion>0")
counts <- countsNormalization(counts, proximal=40, distal=40)
counts <- getWeightedBindingScore(counts)
design <- cbind(CTL=1, EXPvsCTL=c(1, 1, 0, 0))
counts <- DBscore(counts, design=design, coef="EXPvsCTL")
res <- doTFEA(counts)
res
plotES(res, TF=TF, outfolder=NA) ## will show same figure as above one
